name: main
text:
static GLchar const fragShader2D[] =
#if GL_ES_VERSION_2_0
	"#version 100\n"
	"precision mediump float;\n"
#else
	"#version 120\n"
#endif
	"uniform sampler2D uTx0;"
	"varying vec2      vUV0;" // (passed from fragment shader)
	"void main() {"
	"	gl_FragColor = texture2D(uTx0, vUV0);"
	"}";
